mapper.select: SELECT grievance_id, tenant_id, employee_id, against_type, against_id, handler_id, escalated_dispute_id, deleted FROM hr_grievance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND escalated_dispute_id IS NOT NULL AND escalated_dispute_id = #{disputeId}

SELECT DISTINCT account.user_id AS userId, account.nick_name AS userName FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.user_id = account.user_id AND membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_role role_config ON role_config.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_config.tenant_id = account.tenant_id WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND role_config.deleted = 0 AND role_config.status = '0' AND role_config.role_key = 'hr' ORDER BY account.user_id

SELECT DISTINCT account.user_id AS userId, account.nick_name AS userName FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.user_id = account.user_id AND membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id JOIN sys_role role_config ON role_config.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_config.tenant_id = account.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu role_menu ON role_menu.role_id = role_config.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = role_menu.menu_id WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND role_config.deleted = 0 AND role_config.status = '0' AND (role_config.role_key = 'admin' OR menu.perms = 'hr:grievance:manage:handle') ORDER BY account.user_id
SELECT user_id AS userId, nick_name AS userName FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0'
SELECT dept_name FROM sys_dept WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0
